title: Touch in the right place
line: Makes touch line up with the picture in Gaming Mode (it's turned 90 degrees).
symptom: gamescope-session-plus marks this sideways panel as external, so gamescope turns the picture but not touch input.
why: gamescope-session-plus device-quirks starts these OneXPlayer / AOKZOE panels as PANEL_TYPE=external with ORIENTATION=left, so touch isn't turned with the picture. Confirmed on the OneXFly F1 (Bazzite 5581); offered on the other models in such blocks.
risk_note: One session file that only sets the panel type, checked against the DMI ids.

changes.detail: Sets PANEL_TYPE=internal for this handheld, so gamescope turns touch with the screen.

undo: Deletes the file. Takes effect next time Gaming Mode starts.
bazzite: Not fixed (issue 5581; waits for ChimeraOS/gamescope-session PR 128).
steamos: Not affected the same way (SteamOS uses its own session).

probe.what: Reads gamescope-session's own device-quirks file: once it treats this handheld's panel as internal, nothing is needed.

watch.note: The upstream fix (open on 2026-11-10). Merged = fixed once Bazzite packages it.
